info.name: WebSankul API — Complete 2026
info.description:
Production-ready Postman collection for the WebSankul ed-tech platform.

4 API surfaces: Client (Mobile/Web), Admin, Educator, Promoter.

SETUP (3 steps):
1. Import this file + WebSankul.postman_environment.json
2. Set base_url = http://localhost:3000/api/v1
3. Run login request for your surface — token auto-saves to environment

TOKEN FLOW:
- Client: POST Validate OTP → saves client_token + client_refresh_token
- Admin: POST Login (Admin Auth) → saves admin_token + admin_refresh_token
- Educator: POST Login (Educator Auth) → saves educator_token
- Promoter: POST Login (Promoter Auth) → saves promoter_token

REQUEST CHAINING: Test scripts auto-capture IDs (course_id, order_id, razorpay_order_id, etc.) into environment variables for subsequent requests.

RESPONSE ENVELOPE: { success, code, data, message, messages }
ERRORS: 400 bad request, 401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden/gated, 404 not found, 409 conflict, 422 validation, 500 server error
